finding.title: Official material-failure return bypasses new settings ownership protection
evidence: Core prepare rejection calls _returnSubmissionToDraft at397-400; cancellation calls _returnToDraft at551-556; detached composer _returnToDraft at564-582 prepends captured submission text and merges attachments into whatever draft now exists.
Attachment binding callback runs after the core restored-draft notification; it reports failure/cancel without invoking onNew.
Current new ownership guard only protects ConversationThread.onNew catch. Its bindComposer preparation-failed callback clears pending/handoff but does not distinguish settings-only B from old A.
finding.impact: After A detaches while materials prepare, B can hold different settings with empty or equal text. A prepare failure/cancel may prepend A text/files into B while retaining B settings. This is inferred from installed source and current draft changes, not a browser-observed failure.
finding.action: Existing owner should keep failed A explicitly recoverable without silently modifying B, using the current owned ConversationThread/private settings boundary and real composer API. Do not patch shared core or broaden shared attachment scope without coordination. Do not create a second independently editable draft store/FSM.
finding.validation: Use actual installed runtime in existing real App preparation-failure and explicit-cancel cases, including settings-only B and equal-text/different-settings B. Existing manual deferred-success/outbox checks cannot prove this path.

reviewState: No fixed implementation decision. Forwarded through manager for current ordinary implementation fix.
